senses.gloss: f.(b. h. אִגֶּ׳; נגר , to join, v. esp.
units: Snh. 11ᵇ; ושלש איגרות וכ׳) tablet, letter, brief, document.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 9:3">Git. IX, 3</cite> (formula of a letter of divorce) <he>ספר … וא׳ … וגט וכ׳</he>.
Ib. 85ᵇ ולא … איגרת … אלא אגרת one must not write (in the letter of divorce) egereth with אי׳ which might mean roof (v. אִיגָר), but &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 64a:3">Keth. 64ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:2:7">Y. Kidd. I, 59ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>א׳ מרד</he> a document stating a wife’s disobedience.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:4:8">Y. Meg. IV, 75ᵇ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:45">Y. Snh. I, 19ᵇ</cite> top <he>א׳ ביקורת</he> a document fixing the value of a property, v. <cite ref="A01754"><he>אַכְרָזָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>אִגָּרוֹת</he>, <he>אִיגָּרוֹת</he>.

M. Kat. III, 3 א׳ שׁל רשות secular, social correspondence, opp. religious correspondence; cmp. Y. ib. 82ᵃ bot.; [commentaries: documents of secular government, v. רָשׁוּת]. Ib.; B. Mets. I, 8 א׳ שׁום א׳ מזון documents relating to legal assessment and to alimony.
